# `console/index.html`

[As built](../../README.md) › [Console screens and styling](../../subsystems/console-screens-and-styling.md) › `index.html`

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Root HTML page of the Fabrika console, hosting the web UI for managing code analysis and generation work through multiple factory processing gates. Loads stylesheets, defines page structure with panel and main content areas, and bootstraps all JavaScript modules that power the application.
